title: MFA Setup Response
description: 200 body for POST /api/v1/mfa/setup. Returned only to the authenticated, enrolling user (enrollment-only or normal JWT). `secret` and `otpauth_uri` carry the same TOTP secret the QR image from GET /api/v1/mfa/setup/qr encodes (identical issuer and account label), so a client can offer manual key entry. The response is credential material: clients MUST NOT log, persist or cache it, and the server sends it with no-store semantics and never logs it. Each call overwrites any pending secret and returns a fresh setup_token.

setup_token.description: Server-issued enrollment token (UUID, 30-minute TTL). Passed to GET /mfa/setup/qr and POST /mfa/setup/verify.

secret.description: Base32 TOTP shared secret for manual entry into an authenticator app.

otpauth_uri.description: otpauth://totp/ provisioning URI (issuer "Traigent", label = the account email) embedding `secret`; identical to the URI the QR image encodes.
